## What changes

The final pin bump before objectui main freezes for the merge into objectstack `ui/` (objectstack#25752 step 2). `.objectstack-sha` moves from `5874d25302cbb80db675eddf1b69198073fbe2a9` to **`5e7cf63e71d92198a77cc88ed22f34afb1e86cb6`**, the objectstack `main` HEAD at 15:01Z. The branch was restarted from objectui `main` at `3b7b04007f` (after #13526).

This is a one-line diff. `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh` rebuilt the pin and the packed manifests in `.objectstack-pin/` came out byte-identical, so `pnpm install` left `pnpm-lock.yaml` unchanged. The only `packages/spec` change in the range is a `describe()` string in `ui/page.zod.ts` plus a liveness ledger file. No changeset is owed, because no published source changes.
